mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS revision_id, v.detected_mime AS detected_media_type, r.fence_generation AS revision_fence_generation, m.lifecycle_generation AS material_lifecycle_generation, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, b.original_object_key AS object_key, b.original_object_version_id AS object_version_id, b.content_sha256 AS content_sha256, b.byte_size AS byte_size, b.detected_mime AS content_type FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_content_blob b ON b.id = v.content_blob_id JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage IN ('CREATED', 'EXTRACTING') AND v.ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND b.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = 'EXTRACT_NATIVE' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

SELECT r.id AS revision_id, r.version_id, r.fence_generation AS revision_fence_generation, m.lifecycle_generation AS material_lifecycle_generation, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, p.id AS page_id, p.page_no, image.object_key AS page_image_key, image.object_version_id AS page_image_version_id, image.content_sha256 AS page_image_sha256, image.byte_size AS page_image_size, image.content_type AS page_image_content_type, canonical.object_key AS canonical_key, canonical.object_version_id AS canonical_version_id, canonical.content_sha256 AS canonical_sha256, canonical.byte_size AS canonical_size, canonical.content_type AS canonical_content_type, structure.object_key AS structure_key, structure.object_version_id AS structure_version_id, structure.content_sha256 AS structure_sha256, structure.byte_size AS structure_size, structure.content_type AS structure_content_type FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_page p ON p.revision_id = r.id JOIN material_page_artifact image ON image.revision_id = p.revision_id AND image.page_no = p.page_no AND image.artifact_kind = 'PAGE_IMAGE' JOIN material_page_artifact canonical ON canonical.revision_id = p.revision_id AND canonical.page_no = p.page_no AND canonical.artifact_kind = 'CANONICAL_PAGE' JOIN material_revision_artifact structure ON structure.revision_id = r.id AND structure.artifact_kind = 'DOCUMENT_STRUCTURE' JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage = 'VISUAL_ANALYSIS' AND v.ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = 'ANALYZE_VISUALS' AND j.work_key = 'root' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY p.page_no

SELECT r.id AS revision_id, r.version_id, v.material_id, m.owner_type, m.owner_key, r.fence_generation AS revision_fence_generation, m.lifecycle_generation AS material_lifecycle_generation, r.fingerprint AS processing_fingerprint, evidence.object_key AS evidence_manifest_key, evidence.object_version_id AS evidence_manifest_version_id, evidence.content_sha256 AS evidence_manifest_sha256, evidence.byte_size AS evidence_manifest_size, evidence.content_type AS evidence_manifest_content_type FROM material_processing_revision r JOIN material_version v ON v.id = r.version_id JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id JOIN material_revision_artifact evidence ON evidence.revision_id = r.id AND evidence.artifact_kind = 'EVIDENCE_MANIFEST' JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.state = 'PROCESSING' AND r.stage = 'INDEXING' AND v.ingest_state = 'PROCESSING' AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.stage = 'BUILD_RETRIEVAL_CHUNKS' AND j.work_key = 'root' AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)

SELECT p.page_no, p.width, p.height, p.ocr_status, image.object_key AS page_image_key, image.object_version_id AS page_image_version_id, image.content_sha256 AS page_image_sha256, image.byte_size AS page_image_size, image.content_type AS page_image_content_type, native.object_key AS native_key, native.object_version_id AS native_version_id, native.content_sha256 AS native_sha256, native.byte_size AS native_size, native.content_type AS native_content_type, raw.object_key AS raw_key, raw.object_version_id AS raw_version_id, raw.content_sha256 AS raw_sha256, raw.byte_size AS raw_size, raw.content_type AS raw_content_type FROM material_page p JOIN material_page_artifact image ON image.revision_id = p.revision_id AND image.page_no = p.page_no AND image.artifact_kind = 'PAGE_IMAGE' JOIN material_page_artifact native ON native.revision_id = p.revision_id AND native.page_no = p.page_no AND native.artifact_kind = 'NATIVE_EXTRACTION' LEFT JOIN material_page_artifact raw ON raw.revision_id = p.revision_id AND raw.page_no = p.page_no AND raw.artifact_kind = 'RAW_EXTRACTION' JOIN material_processing_job j ON j.revision_id = p.revision_id WHERE p.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND j.id = #{jobId} AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_owner = #{workerId} AND j.fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND j.lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND ((j.stage = 'OCR_SELECTED_PAGES' AND j.work_key = CONCAT('page:', p.page_no) AND p.ocr_status = 'REQUIRED') OR (j.stage = 'NORMALIZE_CANONICAL_PAGES' AND j.work_key = CONCAT('page:', p.page_no) AND p.canonical_page_key IS NULL)) ORDER BY p.page_no
